seg.seg_rev_note: Two segments: Freight Group and Transit Group. Segment sales = sales to external customers as published. Note: Wabtec later reclassified some businesses between segments (e.g., Q1-14 10-Q shows Q1-13 Freight $313.7m / Transit $301.8m vs. originally reported $305.9m / $309.6m); figures here are as originally reported.
seg.notes: Segment income from operations (and Corporate Activities & Elimination) from the 10-Q segment note; the release does not publish segment operating income. legacy_pl = three-month 'Sales by product' table from the 10-Q segment note (as originally reported). Bridge from Q1-13 10-Q MD&A narrative (release gives none): acquisitions +$41.4m (Freight $2.1m, Transit $39.3m); FX reduced sales $3.7m (Freight $1.6m, Transit $2.1m). Organic not stated.

ngaap.guidance: Affirmed 2013 guidance for EPS of about $5.85 (pre-split basis), with revenues expected to be up about 8-10 percent for the year.
